newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia beheads two Pakistani drug smugglers.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia beheads two Pakistani drug smugglers.

text.p: Saudi Arabia beheaded two Pakistanis on Wednesday for smuggling heroin, the official Saudi Press Agency SPA said.
The agency quoted the interior ministry as saying Mohammad Aleem Khan and Mohammad Amin Mahjoub Basha were beheaded in the Red Sea port city of Jeddah. It gave no further details.

Fifty-one people have been executed in the conservative Moslem kingdom so far this year. Saudi Arabia strictly enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading by the sword convicted murderers, drug smugglers, rapists and other criminals.
